message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to a live clock or real‑time API, so I can’t tell you the precise minute right now.  

**How to check yourself**

| Option | How |
|--------|-----|
| **Phone / computer** | Most devices show multiple time zones in their settings or widgets. Add “New York” or “Eastern Time” to see the current time instantly. |
| **Websites** | Sites such as <https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/usa/new-york> display the up‑to‑second time along with the UTC offset (+/- hours). |
| **Voice assistants** | Ask Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc., “What’s the time in New York?” |

If you’re looking at this outside of U.S. Daylight Saving Time (roughly mid‑March to early November), New York operates on Eastern Daylight Time (EDT, UTC−04:00). Outside those months it switches back to Eastern Standard Time (EST, UTC−05:00).

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
